text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Good tests give developers confidence. When they make changes, they can quickly see if something breaks. Without testing, small mistakes can grow into serious problems, so testing saves time and reduces stress in the long run.
